title: failure.yaml (L1, pack root)
description: The run-level failure index at the pack root — GENERATED by `evidence finalize` from every step-level failure.yaml, never hand-authored. Denormalized rows (test, ordinal, step, status, path, lifted triage_status) so a consumer renders a failure table without opening each record. `path` is pack-root-relative and MUST agree with its own row — path/row consistency, pointer resolution (dangling), and completeness against the records actually present are validator cross-checks. Always written at finalize: a clean run carries `failures: []`. See decision 0044.

generated.description: When finalize generated this index — its endedAt timestamp.

totals.description: Informational tallies (open map). finalize writes at least `failures`.

failures.description: One row per step-level failure.yaml, sorted by test then ordinal.

status.description: The step verdict, mirrored from the record.

path.description: Pack-root-relative pointer to the step record: tests/<test>/steps/<ordinal>-<step>/failure.yaml. Row/path agreement is a validator cross-check (l1.failure_index.invalid).

triage_status.description: Lifted verbatim from the record's triage.status when present.

title.description: Lifted verbatim from the record's title when present.

severity.description: Lifted verbatim from the record's triage.severity when present.
